chars.name: Corvane
chars.cue: Gravelly, deliberate. Serious to roaring in three seconds.

lines: BELASKRO. MY SON.
Nephew. The stairs. NOW.
You are blood. Act like it.
Five.
Four.
Three.
Two.
One.
Someone stand over that child!
On your feet, girl. Not in my house.
Your toast, Majesty.
You're very calm.
If he dies, Majesty, we will talk. At length.
OPEN.
I built this house to keep knives out.
I gave no such order.
Now get out of my house.

chars.name: Queen Sabine
chars.cue: British, graceful. More gracious the worse it gets.

lines: Alive. I'll want to know who sent him.
It's a shield rune, Marquis. It was meant to keep us safe.
Do stop striking it. You'll only tire.
We are both of us parents tonight, Marquis.
How many of them were there?
(says nothing, glass still in hand)
Whoever you are, the Crown is in your debt. Hurry.
I gave that toast. I will not let anyone pretend it was mine.
The Marshals will have everything I can give them.

chars.name: The page
chars.cue: Young, shaking, exalted. Unbowed.

lines: UNBOWED!
Kneel on me all you like.
Look at them run. Look at them.
No houses. No crowns.
You'll get my name and nothing else.

chars.name: Éclair
chars.cue: Clipped, competitive. Allergic to being fussed over.

lines: Point.
You're telegraphing.
Again. Slower, so I can enjoy it.
It's a scratch. Don't fuss.
I said don't fuss. Get the knife.
Princess. Of course it's you.
If you tell my father I needed help, I'll deny it.
Thank you. That will be the only time I say it.
Tell them I was ahead on points.

chars.name: Garrick
chars.cue: Laconic, dry, blunt. Moravel soldier.

lines: Two winters on the wall. You learn to count exits.
Left hand's the bad one. You picked wrong.
I've seen worse. I've buried worse.
Cassian's an idiot. He's also the best I've fought. Go get him.
Don't watch me. Watch the gallery.
Owe you one. I pay.
The border. Tell them. Somebody listen.

chars.name: Noémie
chars.cue: Québécoise. Loud, joyful, swears in church words.

lines: Tabarnak! Pas à soir, mon chum!
Tu veux danser? On va danser!
Câlisse, ça fait mal!
Mon père, bénis-moi. J'vas en avoir besoin.
Vive la Varenthal!
Ferme tes yeux!
Hé, le chasseur! Just like the frontier, non?
Ostie. I owe you a shot. Ten shots.
J'voulais juste danser.

chars.name: Aurelian
chars.cue: Courtly, a beat too eager. Turns his ring when nervous.

lines: One is not, in fact, decorative!
I trained for this. I did. I did.
Oh. That is rather a lot of blood.
My aunt is on that dais. Somebody help my aunt.
Tell me what to do. Please.
Is it disloyal to want to live through this?
You came for me. Nobody comes for me.
Was I a real contender?

chars.name: Rowan
chars.cue: Smooth and vain. Always aware of who is watching.

lines: Not the face.
Is everyone seeing this? Good.
That was a new coat.
Odile! Behind me. No, behind me.
Odile, don't look.
A blade, if you please. I'm wasted unarmed.
We shall say I had it handled. Agreed?
Tell them I was magnificent.

chars.name: Cassian
chars.cue: Arrogant, performative, nineteen. Upstairs, behind the wards.

lines: FATHER! Someone's on the roof!
Is that all you've got?
He's not angry. He's just counting.
…Father?
(silence)
About time. Hit him and I'll set him on fire.
Cousin. You dress badly and you arrive late.
Is that all you've got?
The crowd would have loved that one.
I've had worse from Garrick.
Don't tell him I called for him.

chars.name: Wrent
chars.cue: Rough, raspy, low. Runs at the fire, plans later.

lines: The ones by you, Gus! I've got this one!
You want them, you come through me.
Marshals! On me!
Don't look at me. Look at them. That's an order.
Good work, Gus. Keep going.
I'm fine. I've been stabbed by better.
Should've made a plan first. You'd have told me that.
I know in my heart what's right. I chose it.
Gus. You were never equipment.

chars.name: Marshals arriving
chars.cue: Round 6, at the garden doors.

lines: Arcane Marshals! Everyone down!
Gallery's clear!
Lieutenant's down! Healer!

chars.name: In Gus's head
chars.cue: Flat, mechanical. Marshal Intelligence.

lines: Handler signal lost. Annex C unsealed.
Unclassified sensation detected. Note the time. Continue.

chars.name: A Knife
chars.cue: Flat, professional. One mark, nothing personal.

lines: Let go. You're not the one I'm here for.
Step aside. This isn't yours.
Hand. Off. Now.
My mark. My signal. My exit. That's all there is.

chars.name: The Hand
chars.cue: Patient, unhurried. Trusts the count.

lines: Four left, my lord. No hurry.
You're not on the contract. Leave and I'll forget you.
Ah. Finally, some work.
Noted.
Another night, then.

chars.name: A marksman
chars.cue: Sharp, from the loggia rail.

lines: Clear of him, or you're next!
Off the mark!
Tablets. Go.

chars.name: Honey Cruller
chars.cue: Unhurried, immaculately polite. The knife lands in the second half.

lines: My daughter is on that floor, and you are standing here.
We are guests. Guests, it seems, are stabbed.
Niece. Bring her back, and Meow will remember it.
Meow remembers a courtesy. I shall remember this one personally.
I will have a name. I am very patient.

chars.name: Tasmin Dreveth
chars.cue: In her chair. Spared, and knows it.

lines: Why not me? Why did they walk past me?
I can't get up. Somebody, I can't get up.
Go! I'm the only safe one here!

chars.name: Lady Odile
chars.cue: Rowan's sister. Composed until tonight.

lines: Rowan! ROWAN!
He's an idiot but he's my idiot. Please!

chars.name: The crowd
chars.cue: A hundred and fifty voices.

lines: The doors! Get to the doors!
My daughter's in there!
Who hired the band?
The Queen's toast. They waited for the Queen's toast.

chars.name: Captain Dunmore
chars.cue: House guard captain. Pale. After the fight.

lines: Your seal, my lord. Guards to the gates, so the Dreveth party wouldn't feel watched.
Under-Steward Grey handed it to me himself.
It was in your hand, my lord. I'd swear to it.
